You hit for +1 damage, +2 critical hit, and +1 damage per ally sacrificed to this attack

conservative.requirements: Engaged with target, Strength 5+. You methodically sacrifice lesser minions to set up the target for a crippling blow. Each ally you sacrifice is automatically killed, but reduces the difficulty modifier of this attack by {Dc}. Each henchman ally sacrificed instead adds {Dc} to the dice pool. §F defenses

success.description: The brutish orc carves through the engagement, heedless of friend or foe. The attack inflicts +2 damage, +1 critical hit.
As above, +1 damage for each goblin killed to empower this attack.
As above, +1 damage for each goblin or snotling killed to empower this attack.

boon.description: The attack has a rating of Fear 2.

chaosStar.description: All greenskins in the engagement suffer 1 wound.

reckless.requirements: Used By: Orcs. Engaged with target. Special: The GM may choose to kill any number of snotlings or goblins in the current engagement as the orc hacks through it. For each goblin killed, reduce the difficulty modifier by {Dc}. For each snotling killed, add {Dm} to the attack check.
